app.title: LifeLink KH
app.tagline: Connecting blood donors with the people who need them
app.portalCardBody: Every open blood request, the donors who accepted it, and the one write this portal has — confirming a donation.

signIn.title: Admin sign-in
signIn.intro: This portal is for LifeLink administrators. Donors and requesters use the mobile app.
signIn.noSelfSignup: There is no self sign-up. Admin accounts are created by the project team.
signIn.rememberHint: Your password is not stored here — let your browser save it when it offers.
signIn.failedRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
signIn.failedUnreachable: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

password.title: Change password
password.intro: Changing the password for the account you are signed in as.
password.failedWrongCurrent: That is not your current password.
password.failedMismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
password.failedUnchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
password.noteOtherSessions: Sessions already signed in elsewhere stay valid until they expire — there is no remote sign-out.

time.minutes: {count, plural, =1 {1 minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}
time.hours: {count, plural, =1 {1 hour ago} other {# hours ago}}

portal.title: Open requests
portal.unreachable: Could not load the request list.
portal.confirmFailed: Could not confirm that donation. It may already be confirmed.
portal.confirmDialogBody: This records that '{name}' donated blood on '{date}'. This cannot be undone.
portal.searchPlaceholder: Search by hospital or blood type
portal.pendingHint: No donor has been alerted about these yet. Check the need is real — call the family or the hospital — then approve it, or reject it with a reason the requester will see.
portal.approveDialogBody: Matching donors nearby will get a push alert straight away. This cannot be undone.
portal.rejectDialogBody: No donor is alerted. The requester sees your reason in the app.
portal.rejectReasonPlaceholder: e.g. The hospital has no record of this patient.
portal.reviewApproved: Request approved. Donors are being alerted.
portal.reviewRejected: Request rejected. The requester has been told.
portal.reviewGone: That request is no longer waiting — it was cancelled or already reviewed.
portal.reviewFailed: Could not review that request. Try again.
